final_text:
Here are the top 5 customers to put on an account-review shortlist, ranked by invoiced sales excluding tax.

**Source:** the product is DAILY_INVOICED_SALES, version 101, queried from `HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.L2P_RELEASE.DAILY_INVOICED_SALES_V0101`. It was released 2026-10-23 and has 241 rows. The figures are synthetic Northstar Supply data.

| Rank | Customer (ID) | Sales excl. tax | Invoice lines | Distinct items | Active days | First – last invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fictional Customer 010 (10) | 4,964.45 | 17 | 11 | 7 | 2026-01-05 – 2026-02-22 |
| 2 | Fictional Customer 008 (8) | 4,719.06 | 22 | 13 | 7 | 2026-01-11 – 2026-03-03 |
| 3 | Fictional Customer 019 (19) | 4,297.74 | 16 | 11 | 6 | 2026-01-08 – 2026-02-21 |
| 4 | Fictional Customer 018 (18) | 4,072.60 | 18 | 10 | 8 | 2026-01-08 – 2026-02-26 |
| 5 | Fictional Customer 004 (4) | 3,756.35 | 22 | 12 | 9 | 2026-01-06 – 2026-02-21 |

- **How sales are calculated:** invoice extended price minus tax, added up for each customer. The product doesn't record a currency, so no currency is shown.
- **The data is old:** it only covers invoices from 2026-01-05 to 2026-03-03, about seven months ago. It doesn't show anything these customers have done since early March.
- **The gaps are small:** all five are within about 1,200 of each other, so the order is fairly loose. Customers 008 and 004 have the most invoice lines (22 each), and 004 has the most active days (9).

**What this can't tell you:** the product has no data on marketing consent, campaign responses, margin, causal uplift, returns or discounts. So this ranking doesn't show whether these customers can be contacted, whether they're profitable, or whether a campaign would change their buying. It only shows how much they were invoiced in the period covered.
